name: 07-silence-verdict-no-response
description: Un-collapsed Deciding: the patience window closes and the host answers 'silence'. The machine re-arms straight back to listening — NO turn-end, NO response-start, no response park. Same event times as 05, whose 'speak' answer parks in responding and turns the 4500 resume into a barge-in; here nothing was spoken, so the turn never ended and the 4500 resume is the SAME thought continuing (§4b) — no second turn-start, no second turn id.
